session_spawn.title: Hand work to an agent
session_spawn.description: Start an agent on a task. Writes a session, the first entry naming the provider, model and effort, and the session's claim on the task; committing that starts the agent, so a task somebody else already holds refuses the whole request. With wait, returns how the run ended — its brief and its exit code — instead of the session id.

task.description: the work it is being handed, which it claims

provider.description: who runs it — a provider whose transport is a command line

model.description: which model it serves the run with

effort.description: how hard to think, where the model accepts such a setting

instruction.description: what to tell it (default the task's id and title — it holds the claim and reads the rest itself)

wait.description: block until the run is over and return how it ended

timeout.description: how long to wait — 45m, 2h, or bare seconds (default 30m)

session_wait.title: Block until it is over
session_wait.description: Wait for a session to end, then return its brief and the exit code its run ended on. A session still going when the timeout passes is reported as still going, never killed.

timeout.description: how long to wait — 45m, 2h, or bare seconds (default 30m)

session_peek.title: A glance at the transcript
session_peek.description: The end of a session's transcript as the graph holds it, one line per entry, plus what it is doing now. Reads a bounded number of entries, never the provider's own log file.
